long_biography.plain_text:
Daniele Cincotti’s business identity centres on ESTEN, the Battipaglia packaging company he administers. ESTEN trades in packaging materials and is connected to Deriblok’s industrial network, placing his role within an established platform focused on polymer films and associated distribution.

Deriblok grew from flat-film production in the early 1980s into a specialist maker of polyethylene stretch film. Its process combines multilayer extrusion, automated thickness control, rewinding, quality testing and international distribution. Cincotti’s position through ESTEN is managerial and operational, while the older manufacturing platform was created by Davide Cincotti. The business serves industrial customers across export markets.
